examples.en: They believe good people go to heaven.
examples.ko: 그들은 착한 사람들이 천국에 간다고 믿는다.

examples.en: The view from the mountain was like heaven.
examples.ko: 산에서 본 경치는 마치 천국 같았다.

examples.en: This bag is very heavy.
He carried a heavy box.
She hurt her heel while running.
These shoes have very high heels.
What is your height in centimeters?
The building's height is over 100 meters.
The prince is the heir to the throne.
She is the only heir to her family's fortune.
A helicopter flew over the city.
examples.ko: 헬리콥터 한 대가 도시 위로 날아갔다.

examples.en: They used a helicopter to rescue the hikers.
examples.ko: 그들은 등산객들을 구조하기 위해 헬리콥터를 사용했다.

examples.en: In the story, bad people go to hell.
examples.ko: 이야기 속에서 나쁜 사람들은 지옥에 간다.

examples.en: The soldiers said the battle was like hell.
examples.ko: 군인들은 그 전투가 마치 지옥 같았다고 말했다.

examples.en: Hello?
She said hello to me.
Wear a helmet on your bike.
He forgot his helmet today.
Can I help you?
Thank you for your help.
The road was closed; hence, we took a detour.
He was ill and hence could not attend the meeting.
examples.ko: 그는 아파서 회의에 참석할 수 없었다.

examples.en: Glad you’re here.
Come here, please.
This palace is part of our cultural heritage.
The town is proud of its long heritage.
He is my favorite hero.
The movie has a brave hero.
She hesitated before answering the question.
Don't hesitate to ask for help.
The cat is hiding under the bed.
He tried to hide his feelings.
The company has a clear hierarchy of managers.
examples.ko: 그 회사는 분명한 관리자 위계가 있다.

examples.en: Every animal group has its own social hierarchy.
examples.ko: 모든 동물 무리에는 저마다의 사회적 위계가 있다.

examples.en: The mountain is very high.
The bird flew high above.
The teacher highlighted the important words in the text.
examples.ko: 선생님은 본문에서 중요한 단어들을 강조 표시했다.

examples.en: The goal was the highlight of the game.
We drove on the highway to the beach.
The highway was busy during the holidays.
We went on a hike.
They hiked up the hill.
We climbed the small hill.
A house sits on the hill.
examples.ko: 언덕 위에 집 한 채가 있다.

examples.en: Can you give me a hint?
She hinted that she would come to the party.
The company hired ten new workers.
examples.ko: 그 회사는 새 직원 열 명을 고용했다.

examples.en: We need to hire a good teacher.
I like history class.
This book is about history.
He hit the ball hard.
Don't hit your brother.
Reading is my hobby.
What is your hobby?
Please hold my bag.
She holds the baby gently.
There is a hole in my sock.
The dog dug a hole in the yard.
We have a holiday today.
I love summer holidays.
The church is considered a holy place.
People from many countries visit this holy site.
examples.ko: 여러 나라 사람들이 이 성스러운 장소를 방문한다.

examples.en: I go home after school.
Our home is very warm.
I finished my homework.
She helps me with homework.
It was a(n honest) mistake.
He is always honest with me.
Bees make honey from flowers.
She put honey in her tea.
It is a great honor to meet you.
The town honored the firefighters for their courage.
examples.ko: 그 마을은 소방관들의 용기를 기려 존경을 표했다.

examples.en: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.
The fish was hooked on the first try.
I hope you feel better.
She never lost hope.
The sun rose slowly over the horizon.
We watched the ship disappear beyond the horizon.
examples.ko: 우리는 배가 수평선 너머로 사라지는 것을 지켜보았다.

examples.en: She felt horror when she saw the snake.
He loves watching horror movies at night.
examples.ko: 그는 밤에 공포 영화 보는 것을 좋아한다.

examples.en: She rides a horse well.
The horse ran across the field.

He went to the hospital.
The city will host the next Olympic Games.
examples.ko: 그 도시는 다음 올림픽을 개최할 것이다.

examples.en: She was a kind host at the party.

examples.ko: 그는 낯선 사람에게 적대적인 눈빛을 보냈다.

examples.en: It is very hot today.

We stayed at a nice hotel.
The hotel offers free breakfast every morning.
examples.ko: 그 호텔은 매일 아침 무료 조식을 제공한다.

examples.en: The movie is one hour long.
I waited for an hour.

Every household should recycle its trash.

How did they travel?
How are you today?
